name: BlackEarth Minerals NL
summary: BlackEarth Minerals NL engages in the exploration and development of graphite properties. It focuses on the exploration of Maniry and Ianapera graphite projects located in Madagascar The company also holds interests in the Donnelly River project that covers 2 exploration licenses; the Greenhills project, which covers 4 exploration licenses; the Northern Gully project that covers 1 granted exploration license; and the Yalbra project, which covers 1 granted exploration license in West Australian. BlackEarth Minerals NL was incorporated in 2016 and is based in West Perth, Australia.
